subtitle: Lesson 25 · Storage & Files

code:
C:\   OS, SQL Server binaries
D:\   Data files (.mdf/.ndf) — random I/O
E:\   Transaction log (.ldf) — sequential
F:\   TempDB — highest churn, fastest disk
G:\   Backups — never shares a disk with data
caption: A starting point, not a law — reasoning matters more than the letters.
